goal: agentfiles doctor says when Claude Code did not load a plugin or skill the last sync installed, so a skill that syncs cleanly but never reaches the model is caught (ROADMAP R16, Claude Code half).
changed: agentfiles/loaded.py: reads Claude Code's init event from claude -p in an empty folder and stops it once the event arrives (SIGTERM, so Claude Code removes its session pidfile); compares its plugins and skills with the plugins and skill folders of the last sync's agentfiles-local marketplace.
agentfiles/cli.py: doctor runs that check, skipped with a -- line when claude is missing or the last sync installed no Claude Code plugins.
A marketplace folder that is gone is a problem line, not a traceback; a plugin whose plugin.json sets its own skills paths gets a note and no skill comparison.
tests/test_loaded.py: compare() on each problem kind, and doctor after a real sync through a fake claude that replays an init event, including a deleted marketplace.
README.md: the doctor lines say what it now checks.
ROADMAP R16: status for the Claude Code half, with what was measured and why the first Done-when clause cannot be met as worded.

claims.claim: After a clean sync, doctor reports every agentfiles plugin and skill loaded; after a sync of a skill with no description it names that skill and exits 1; after the fix it exits 0.
claims.check: .changes/2026-11-27-r16-doctor-claude-code/proof.sh under a scratch HOME with a local upstream source and the real claude: clean sync then doctor exit 0; alpha's description removed, sync exit 0, doctor names agentfiles:alpha and exits 1; description restored, doctor exit 0; no session pidfile left. Rerun with .changes/2026-11-27-r16-doctor-claude-code/proof.sh.
claims.remaining: Only Claude Code. Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and pi wait on R0 and H4.

claims.claim: On a real machine with a full user setup the check is clean: every agentfiles-local plugin and skill is loaded and nothing extra.
claims.check: bin/agentfiles doctor from this branch on the maintainer's real HOME prints the ok line for the load check.
claims.remaining: Run on one machine; its output names that machine's setup, so it is not recorded in this public repo.

claims.claim: No skill header that agent-kit's tools/validate.py accepts makes Claude Code 2.1.325 drop the skill, except user-invocable: false, which hides it on purpose.
claims.check: About 35 header variants loaded with claude -p --plugin-dir: drops happen only without a usable string description (none, a mapping, a YAML error, a tab, no frontmatter) and with user-invocable: false. tools/validate.py check_skill run on those six: errors on the first five, a warning only on user-invocable.
claims.remaining: So the first Done-when clause cannot be met as written; rewording it is Beau's call.

claims.claim: Reading the init event sends nothing to the model.
claims.check: The process is stopped when the init event arrives, which Claude Code emits before its first request; no usage was measured. Two doctor runs in a scratch HOME left no session pidfile and no agentfiles-doctor entry in ~/.claude.json.
claims.remaining: It does run the user's SessionStart hooks, as any claude start does.

claims.claim: The suite passes and the lock is unchanged.
claims.check: make test (121 tests, OK), bin/agentfiles lock --frozen exit 0, verify-work's test_guard.py --base origin/main: 0 findings
